failed_run.error: evaluation first timestamp does not match frozen temporal lock

root_cause.detail: pd.to_datetime(..., utc=True).astype('int64') preserves the parsed datetime unit. Under pandas 3.0.5, the microsecond-precision OBD timestamp strings are represented at microsecond resolution, whereas pd.Timestamp(...).value is nanoseconds. The equality check therefore compared microseconds to nanoseconds without any source-data or temporal-split mismatch.

authorized_erratum.timestamp_conversion: Convert parsed evaluation timestamps explicitly to datetime64[ns] before integer conversion.
authorized_erratum.boundary_validation: Validate evaluation row count and first/last timestamps using timestamp and position columns only before reading evaluation click outcomes.
authorized_erratum.shared_selection_helper: Use one Study 2 evaluation-row slicing helper for both the outcome-free boundary pass and the scored evaluation pass to prevent split-selection drift.
authorized_erratum.runner_audit_artifact: Precreate an incomplete Study 2 result record immediately after the exact qualified model is reproduced and before evaluation opens; overwrite it on terminal success or handled failure.

rerun_rule: A single corrected Study 2 primary OPE rerun is authorized after this erratum and its regression tests pass review/CI. No outcome-derived tuning or secondary analysis is authorized before that rerun completes.
